patch_description:
This crossover keeps the strongest elements from the prior variants: short-horizon returns, rolling z-normalization, volatility/efficiency regime shifts, and momentum × volatility interactions. It also tightens the feature set around 5–20 bar windows to improve regime robustness while preserving a small number of longer anchors for context. 

On the model side, I reduce over-regularization and slightly increase effective expressivity to fight prediction collapse and recover slope on validation. The result is intended to generalize better across the train→test→val regime shift without exceeding the feature limit or changing the external interface.
